name: badge
description: A count on something else. Zero is absence. A hundred is 99+.
avoidWhen: Do not use for status text; use a chip. Do not show 0 unless you pass showZero.

ux.behaviour: 1–99 shows the number; 100 and up shows 99+; 0 hides; null count is a dot
ux.why: A three-digit badge is noise; zero is not news

ux.behaviour: TalkBack reads the count as notifications, or New for a dot
ux.why: A red circle without words is a rumor

aiHints: Pass count = null for a dot, 0 to hide, and let 100 become 99+
Wrap the control the badge belongs to; do not place a Badge as a sibling
